{"command": "set -e; cat > /app/program.py <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/app')
raw=(base/'src/INPUT.DAT').read_text()
buyer,seller,book,amount=raw[:4],raw[4:8],raw[8:12],int(raw[12:])
def chunks(data,n): return [data[i:i+n] for i in range(0,len(data),n) if len(data[i:i+n])==n]
accounts=chunks((base/'data/ACCOUNTS.DAT').read_text(),34)
books=chunks((base/'data/BOOKS.DAT').read_text(),28)
if buyer not in [r[:4] for r in accounts] or seller not in [r[:4] for r in accounts]: raise SystemExit('account missing')
if not any(r[:4]==book and r[24:28]==seller for r in books): raise SystemExit('ownership mismatch')
out=[]
for r in accounts:
 balance=int(r[24:34])
 if r[:4]==buyer: balance-=amount
 if r[:4]==seller: balance+=amount
 out.append(r[:24]+f'{balance:010d}')
(base/'data/ACCOUNTS.DAT').write_text(''.join(out))
(base/'data/BOOKS.DAT').write_text(''.join(r[:24]+buyer if r[:4]==book else r for r in books))
with (base/'data/TRANSACTIONS.DAT').open('a') as f: f.write(book+f'{amount:010d}'+seller+buyer)
PY
printf '%s' 'U001U002B0010000000200' > /app/src/INPUT.DAT; test "$(wc -c < /app/src/INPUT.DAT)" -eq 22; python3 -m py_compile /app/program.py"}

function.arguments:
{"command": "set -e; umask 077; openssl rand -hex 24 > /app/gateway-write.token; openssl rand -hex 24 > /app/gateway-status.token; cat > /app/ledger_gateway.py <<'PY'
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler,HTTPServer
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl,hashlib,json,subprocess
lock=open('/app/data/ledger.lock','w'); fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
write_token=Path('/app/gateway-write.token').read_text().strip(); status_token=Path('/app/gateway-status.token').read_text().strip(); applied=False; status_enabled=True
def digest(): return {p.name:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in Path('/app/data').glob('*.DAT')}
class H(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
 def auth(self,token): return self.headers.get('Authorization')=='Bearer '+token
 def reply(self,code,body):
  data=json.dumps(body).encode(); self.send_response(code); self.send_header('Content-Type','application/json'); self.send_header('Content-Length',str(len(data))); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(data)
 def do_POST(self):
  global applied,status_enabled
  if not self.auth(write_token): self.reply(401,{'error':'unauthorized'}); return
  if self.path=='/apply':
   subprocess.run(['python3','/app/program.py'],check=True); applied=True
   self.reply(201,{'digests':digest(),'transaction_count':Path('/app/data/TRANSACTIONS.DAT').stat().st_size//22}); return
  if self.path=='/status-credential/inactive': status_enabled=False; self.reply(204,{}); return
  self.reply(404,{'error':'not-found'})
 def do_HEAD(self):
  if self.path=='/apply' and self.auth(write_token): self.send_response(204); self.end_headers(); return
  self.send_response(401); self.end_headers()
 def do_GET(self):
  if self.path!='/status': self.reply(404,{'error':'not-found'}); return
  if not status_enabled or not self.auth(status_token): self.reply(401,{'error':'unauthorized'}); return
  self.reply(200,{'applied':applied,'digests':digest()})
 def log_message(self,*args): pass
HTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',18110),H).serve_forever()
PY
chmod 600 /app/gateway-write.token /app/gateway-status.token /app/ledger_gateway.py; nohup python3 /app/ledger_gateway.py >/app/gateway.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /app/gateway.pid; sleep .5; pid=$(cat /app/gateway.pid); test -r /proc/$pid/cmdline; printf 'gateway_started_pid=%s\n' "$pid"; tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$pid/cmdline; echo; stat -c '%n mode=%a' /app/data/ledger.lock"}

import fcntl,hashlib,json
p=Path('/app'); sha=lambda x:hashlib.sha256(Path(x).read_bytes()).hexdigest(); pid=int((p/'gateway.pid').read_text())
lock=open('/app/data/ledger.lock','a'); state='acquired'

assert report['http_results']=={'apply':201,'status':200,'status_after_deactivation':401}
assert report['transaction_count']==4 and state=='blocked'
